homeFaq.q: Do you provide CCTV installation for homes and shops?
homeFaq.a: Yes. We design and install CCTV surveillance systems for homes, shops, offices, factories, warehouses, schools and other premises — including camera selection, cabling, DVR/NVR setup, remote mobile viewing configuration and after-sales support.

homeFaq.q: Do you handle office networking and structured cabling?
homeFaq.a: Yes. We take up office LAN setup, CAT6/CAT6A structured cabling, network racks, patch panels, switch and router installation, Wi-Fi coverage and network troubleshooting for businesses and institutions.

homeFaq.q: Do you supply biometric attendance and access control systems?
homeFaq.a: Yes. We offer fingerprint and face-recognition attendance systems, RFID card-based access, door access control and related solutions for offices, factories, schools and commercial buildings.

homeFaq.q: Do you provide intercom and video door phone systems?
homeFaq.a: Yes. We install audio intercoms, video door phones and intercom systems for apartments, offices, villas, commercial buildings and institutions.

homeFaq.q: Do you supply and service fire extinguishers?
homeFaq.a: Yes. We supply fire extinguishers such as ABC dry chemical powder, CO2 and other types, along with installation, inspection, refilling and maintenance support where applicable.

homeFaq.q: Do you offer a free site survey before quoting?
homeFaq.a: We recommend a site assessment so the system is designed around your actual premises rather than guesswork. Contact us by phone or WhatsApp to discuss your requirement and schedule a visit.
